name: The Hood-Pin
description: A pin of yellowed bone a finger long, its head carved to a plain round knob, the shank worn smooth on one side by cloth. It came out of Lowsong's smoke into your hand as the sixth light caught. To anybody else it's a bone pin. To you it hums, and what it hums is yours: the east stair again, the wind coming down it off the lantern room, a hand from a turn above pulling your hood forward and pinning it. Nothing you would ever burn.
